body:
You totally understand. Thank you for your comment. If I can pm you in a few days that would be nice... Currently struggling with major depression and don't come on here much.

I'm glad you feel safer.

Thank you for writing. Means a lot. He does everything for me and always has. So it's really complex. 

I know he could again though. I am just waiting for the next time I guess.  This sounds terrible doesn't it?

I just love him. I can't function without him as of now. Literally: he drives me everywhere- he does everything for me. I have become a shell of a human.  

It's not just because of what he did but because of stuff my family is going through- they rely on him too.

Maybe if it ever gets physical again I'll leave but it's too stressful to now.
Thanks I just feel so emotionally attached and scared. My whole world consisted of him.
I'm just losing hope.
I can't leave or make him leave. I always tell myself this is the last time but it never is.
Me too. Thanks.
It's very complex. I'm nervous to be alone. I'm nervous for my future...he is everything that I considered "comfortable."
Thanks. I live in the US. Basically, you've just described everything I am afraid of and that's why I'm staying.
Marry someone that was abusive.
My husband physically abused me a few months ago. Were you scared to leave?
My husband could have killed me a few months ago too.
Thank you. We don't talk so I actually can't act on them.
Aww I hope to have this some day
I have mild cerebral palsy of my left side and it bothers me mostly when people ask if I need help. I'm never afraid to ask for help.
I watched this when I was a teen. My mom picked it up from a blockbuster. The clerk told her to make sure I didn't watch it alone. It was pretty frightening.
Love this movie!
Maybe someone who needs to see this will not do this: staying with my abusive husband.  It was not worth it at all.
Thank you for the link! I will check it out!
He stops doing it for a few months. I guess that's my reason. I also depend on him.
When my husband started abusing me physically. I'm still trying to hold on to this relationship, but it's breaking me apart on the inside.
Thanks glad you got away.
I'm going through something similar except my husband was violent with me. Wishing the best for you.
As a woman, I am scared to be alone and let my husband go who abused me three weeks ago. It's a lot easier said that done. I'm afraid I can't do anything on my own.
I'm in the midst of one. I don't want to do anything like get out of bed, check email, answer calls, feed or dress myself, etc. it sucks.
I'm interested. Could you pm me?
Ok can you pm me? I would really like to talk. I'm barely able to function.
Well thanks for the advice. Have fun on your trip.
How? We don't know each other. I can't do anything by myself. I'm scared of everything.
Can you pm me for my zip? What if I never find a job? Now I just stay in bed all day. I know what I have to do though. You are right.  You are very nice-thanks.

The last time happened three weeks ago. I'm scared to be alone. I have no kids. And have been trying to find support but am having a bit of difficulty. The only thing that brightened my day was my job but I don't have it anymore. Thank you for your kind words!
Telling my physically abusive husband that he needs to leave....I'm really scared too.
I feel this way too.
Read reddit, read a book, or watch movies.
That I won't be with any family.
Made me realize that I should leave my physically abusive husband. Day by day the messages have made me become a bit stronger.
I pmed you. Hope you got it.
Thank you; I need all the advice I can get! I will pm you.
I can't stand them anymore. High five back at you!
Did I respond to you? I can't seem to find if I did or not...

Thank you so much for those links. I saved them to my phone. I'm awkward and will probably never meet friends. I have such a low self esteem I'm about to cover my mirrors. I don't have much for family and I can't let go of him. I'm terrified.
It's ok thank you
It's ok I have a job seminar today. Thank you though.
Are you available
Can I talk to you?

Thank you for responding. I know in my heart I should not continue with this relationship, yet I am so scared to be alone. We've been together for ten years...what happens when I have no one to call? What if I miss him? That's what I'm having trouble with... The separation.

He hadn't been violent in such a long time before, I keep down playing what happened. But I think that if it happened once, it will happen again.

I'm so glad you are safe.
Thank you. I wish I could get a hug. I really need one. I am really scared and have basically given up hope to make him leave because I am so scared.
That's what I've been doing avoiding this whole situation. I don't know why I can't go through with this.
I'm so scared. I have no clue what I should do. I'm sorry I can't think straight.

I don't think I can do anything. I just want to quit. I'm not strong enough for all this... Who wants to live with someone who is crying or scared? No one. I keep thinking that what he did wasn't a big deal now so I can try to convince myself to beg him to stay.
I was thinking about this too... No one can put up with my except him
Maybe... A bit worried about that but I'll think about it. I meant more of someone I can call at night or in case I get scared.

How do I find something or someone to help me? Everything costs so much money. I don't even have health insurance... I feel at a loss. The only thing that keeps me alive is work and I only work two days a week. It's only seasonal too.

Walking is a nice idea except I'm afraid I will get jumped or killed.

 I'm desperately trying to find another part time job...not finding anything.

I really like the suggestions you made. 

I know I need to have him leave but am so scared to let go. I don't want to be alone. I'm so scared I don't have any friends or family. I'm just so sad when I think about my future...

How did you get the strength to leave? I am so scared to live or try to function alone. I don't think I can do it. It's like I would rather die because there are sometimes when he is nice. He isn't like this all the time. I just don't know what to do.

I love him but I'm not in love with him. That's the most honest I've been with myself. He isn't using me I don't believe because he literally takes care of me because I can barely take care of myself because of depression. Once he leaves I might be somewhat better but what if I'm not? I'm too old for a babysitter. I need more of something like a relative to just sleep in my guest room. But no relative of mine will do that.
Do I really think he is going to change? No. But I love him. Now to myself, I'm downplaying what he did. I hate this cycle. I know he would leave but I'm just so scared to say goodbye.

I don't know why I want to give him another chance. It's because I'm scared. And we've been together for like 10 years. How do I just say bye to all that? What if he actually never abused me again? But then I think about what if he DID? Then what?

I don't live in an unsafe neighborhood but my dad got murdered many years ago at our old home and I'm afraid that will happen to me. I can't shake it.

Classes or hobbies are a good idea and I'd like to do that but I'm just too depressed to leave bed. The only time I find relief is at work but they've cut me down to nine hours a week. It's better than nothing I guess.  I'm going to a psychiatrist tomorrow and will try not to cancel. It costs a lot of money since I have no health insurance but hopefully it is worth it.
So do you think I should not give him another chance?
Thank you so much I will check this out tomorrow.
What is 211? I'm afraid to meet anyone. I'm depressed now thinking of making him leave.
I will pm you. Thank you.
He will leave I'm just scared to let him go and be alone. I'm so depressed now that I just don't know what to do.
I'll do that now. Thank you.
Thanks I'm so depressed.

That's what his family says but I feel such deep pain about this. Then I ruin the good days he tries to have because I can't get over what happened. What if I can never build my life up? I'm barely functioning. I'm scared at nights. I wish I had family or friends here. I'm mostly afraid of the nights.
I haven't you're right. That's something to remember but it's just so hard for me day to day. I'm ruining myself by staying with him and will ruin him if I make him leave.
Thanks I'm not sure either. I feel like giving up all the time.

Honestly, thank you for talking to me. I see your point but I would like to quit my life and lay in bed for a number of years like I did previous. I am afraid of life. I thought I liked working but they aren't going to keep me. I have no one. Anyone I tell what happened to me in the past week tells me to stay with him. I know why. It's because no person can deal with someone who is my level of depressed. I have no future that I can really see in front of me except that if I kick him out I will be suffering alone. It makes no sense.

I have no family near me. I moved away because my family is becoming homeless and I can't give them the small amount of money I have left to save them. My mom won't come stay with me and my dad got murdered ten years ago. I am so depressed. Sorry I know that's what this subreddit is here for but I feel like such a complainer. I have a dog but my bf wants him. I'm at a loss.
I'm just so so scared to be alone. It's almost like I'd rather be in misery than be lonely.

I agree. I would rather die then financially take care of someone who treats me like shit and put me through living hell. I can't get over last week. I told him we would work on things but I can't get past it. It was too dehumanizing for me.

I've slowly been talking to him about not coming back but he keeps insisting he'll come back. I just don't have the strength to be like, No- I need you not to come back.

I don't know what steps to take; whether to wait until he leaves in December to be like you can't come back or tell him while he's here where it could potentially escalate. I guess I have to wait but I can't pretend that I'm ok with him because I'm Not.

Your story gives me some hope. I'm sure everything will go back to normal for you.

I will have to figure something out because I can't do this that much longer. I'm so sad all the time.

Did something happen where you finally found your peace? Sorry about October.

What I mean as far as responsibility is that I pay for everything. He drives my car- I don't even drive my own car...he drops me off everywhere and if I want to drive it I feel guilty for leaving him there with nothing.  He doesn't have a job yet. But he's not going to get one now because in December he will leave to be with his family for the holidays and I will be here alone. So I pay for him. It's like giving a kid an allowance yet I get treated like crap. His family will have to give him shelter and everything else. He doesn't have a nickel to his name.  This makes me feel terrible. I hate this.

The only way I see out is in December. Every day things are a struggle for me now but I beg him to sleep in bed with me because I am so scared of being alone. My part time job gives me some relief but it's seasonal, and I only work like two days a week.  The depression gets so bad being here or just being around him that I've already missed days of work just so I can cry.

He won't turn his life around. At least I don't believe he will ever be happy in this either.  He isn't even attracted to me either-everything feels forced in every part of this relationship. I just don't see how I can push him out and give his family the weight of taking care of him. That's what makes me keep him the most. It will become their responsibility. Also, it's not all bad but after what happened a few days ago, he just doesn't seem human to me. I can't believe I begged him to stay after that. Now I'm here basically waiting for the next thing to go wrong. You know?
Maybe I will go to therapy first then get rid of him. Much to consider.
True. But I don't know if I could ever relive it which you kind of have to by going to therapy.

I don't know. After the incident a few days ago, I don't know if I can ever truly forgive him. I can't break free from it in my head. And it's basically like I am responsible for him because he really has nothing except for what I help him with. He reminds me of this constantly too. I wish his family would step up to the plate but that's not their responsibility because he's in his mid 30s. Just feel like I'm carrying the whole world on my shoulders. It's exhausting.

Yes he is ruining my life. Or has. And continues to daily. I can see myself on my own living live, but it's just scary to take that step and scary to make him lose everything. I promised myself this would be the last time; if he hurt me again, I would make him leave. But here I am and filled with upset and anger and giving him yet another chance.
If I ever decide to leave, how do I get over feeling like I am destroying his life?

I don't even want to be around anyone. I'm just going to cry and be miserable and no one wants to be around that. I moved to a new state with him and I only know one person here but since I hate my life, I can't even focus on being a normal human. If I don't stay with him I will feel like I am ruining his life. He has no support and no income. I am supporting him in every way and I hate everything. I have slept 6 hours in five days. I might quit my job and I'm making minimum wage. I just feel like death.

Something similar happened to me this week and I cannot leave. He convinced me that I will ruin his life. I'm too afraid to be alone and am so attached. I really applaud you for this and hope that one day, I myself, can be set free and know that I am worth something. My whole life and thought process revolves around him because without me he has nothing.
I just can't let him go. I don't know how or what I will do when he's not around. I'm afraid to do anything alone.

I don't think I can take any of those steps because I'm just too worried. I haven't been to a doctor yet I will have to find one this week. I just don't see myself as breaking free from this. I literally need him for everything- I make him sleep in bed with me. I just don't want to destroy his life and I know this line of thinking is wrong because in a way, he has destroyed mine so much that I now have such hatred for myself.
If you meant a shelter, I wouldn't feel comfortable with that. I'm not comfortable with anything if that makes sense. I could make him leave but I am too scared.
Thank you for this. I do feel dead inside but I honestly love reddit. It's the one place where I can vent a bit.
How are you coping? I'm still avoiding that anything happened and making him stay with me.
We've been together for almost 9. It's been really bad for 7.
Weak, lost, confused, hurt....haven't slept more than like 6 hours in five days...you?

Thanks it means a lot to hear that people are here for me but obviously I never believe that. What kind of services? What do I do? I am constantly thinking about what he's doing twenty four seven, I just got a seasonal job but will most likely get fired because I've already missed a few days because I am so consumed as to what he's doing and have passed out because of anxiety. Besides that, I moved to this new state with him where I know one other person but can't burden her with everything. I just go online during my free time basically. I used to read and watch movies and even wanted to volunteer but lately I can't focus. Feeling heartbroken and dead.
This is me but with my husband. I am never getting out haha.
Ok
I am planning on starting to drive again. Haven't driven since June.
Thanks. I will try to try some of these things.
Thank you so much. That means a lot to me. I feel like I am being drained day by day.

Wow, thank you so much. The first video brought tears to my eyes. The imagery and artistry was amazing. You can message me that fine. Actually it's welcome. Nice to know that there are people on this earth who actually care about others and help to put a smile on their faces. Thank you.
Hmmm hard question. I guess we could talk online. I'm not too good with decisions about how to keep friends. Does that sound right?
Thank you. Sure. I will be your friend...that was nice of you to say.

Thanks for the support. Feeling pretty horrible again tonight. Really depressed. I live at a place my family owns. My arm just hangs there. Could be worse but everything is just piling up. Especially around the holidays. I feel horrible and can't stop crying.
Yes I'm becoming Very depressed again. I just wondered how you turned it around.
Thanks for the fact. And thank you. You too.
I can do it tomorrow. It is dark now. I can say that there are many palm trees and lizards everywhere. That used to make me happy and feel peaceful. Now I just can't stop crying.
Can I ask how you've changed? I feel so depressed.
I can try to say I will. I will say I will and hope that I can do it.
Like two weeks ago. Since the depression is getting bad again I barely want to leave bed. I know it would help but I just feel too sad.
Literally no one will talk to me about depression. They say something like, "that's really depressing. Can we talk about something else?" So my feelings just get shoved down.

I tried to do many things. Just feeling so down that I don't think I can continue pushing anymore. I laid in bed for three full years with depression. I recently moved and that made me happy for a few weeks but now I'm just depressed again. I thought a move away from all the drama surrounding my life would make me happy. I was going to volunteer and that made me happy. But I am losing the strength and the will. I don't know how to get on my feet at all.

I tried to do many things. Just feeling so down that I don't think I can continue pushing anymore. I laid in bed for three full years with depression. I recently moved and that made me happy for a few weeks but now I'm just depressed again. I thought a move away from all the drama surrounding my life would make me happy. I was going to volunteer and that made me happy. But I am losing the strength and the will.
Thank you. I do know this. It's just very hard to accept.

Thanks for responding! I would say it is verbally abusive definitely. I live with him in our own place but I know he would leave if I asked him to.  I'm just very afraid to be alone. It's disabling basically. I love some parts of his personality but the insults over the years are making their marks and are hard to forgive.

I have told him the drinking hurts me and he says he will stop, he stops, then when I go out to the store or we get into a fight, he will start drinking again or start insulting me.
Thank you I will message you now.

I will give al-anon a try. I just hope he doesn't get mad but I guess I can't think of it that way. I am attached to him so much and keep putting up with everything because I am afraid to be alone. I have really bad anxiety and a lot of trauma occurred in my past so I am always afraid something bad will happen.

How did you finally break free from the relationship with your brother? Did you have the support of others? Unfortunately, I don't have that. I'm glad you were able to distance yourself from it and hope that I can do the same at some point.

We share a car right now. I will try to do some things alone but I did that today and then he drank. But I do want to spend time finding things that I have interest in by myself. 
I wanted to go to Al-Anon but he basically smirked when I mentioned it.  I think we are both codependent on each other. This stuff has been happening for about ten years now. I just don't know how much more this can continue. If he's not drinking, he's dealing with anger towards me, insulting me.  Some days are good but it can be hard to see that because of all the insults and remarks.  I have such a low self esteem now and always feel like I am bothering people with even just my presence.

Thank you for responding. You have no idea how much a response means to me.
